description.narrative: (Zambia): The Open Spaces activity is thematically focused on Zambia's democratic space, and on safeguarding freedom of expression and association as protected in both the Zambian Bill of Rights and Constitution. Zambian civic and political space was closing, with the previous government taking subtle and overt actions towards authoritarianism and silencing the diverse voices of Zambian citizens, civil society and media, efforts were needed to protect and expand the space for free speech and assembly - in both face-to-face and digital spaces. With FY 2022 funds, the Open Spaces activity will strengthen the long-term viability of 19 independent media outlets, improve digital literacy and cyber security, and support legal and policy reforms for a free and independent media both online and offline. Activities will also strengthen the ability of the media to identify and counter misinformation and disinformation while promoting fact checking. Under USAID/Zambia's Country Development Cooperation Strategy, the activity will support Development Objective 1: Citizen and National Self-Reliance Advanced by More Effective Accountable Governance and to IR 1.1 Citizen's Engagement in National; Development Choices Strengthened. The activity contributes directly to the Administration policy priority of supporting democracy to create a more secure, stable, and prosperous global arena in which the United States can advance its national interests..
